results.question: What is the average product price in each category? Show the category name and average price in kopecks, rounded to the nearest integer.
results.initial_sql:
SELECT 
    c.name AS category_name,
    ROUND(AVG(p.price_cents)) AS average_price_cents
FROM 
    products p
JOIN 
    categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id
GROUP BY 
    c.name
ORDER BY 
    average_price_cents ASC, c.name ASC;
results.final_sql:
SELECT 
    c.name AS category_name,
    ROUND(AVG(p.price_cents)) AS average_price_cents
FROM 
    products p
JOIN 
    categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id
GROUP BY 
    c.name
ORDER BY 
    average_price_cents ASC, c.name ASC;

results.question: How many orders were placed in each month of 2025? Show the month in YYYY-MM format and the count.
results.initial_sql:
SELECT 
    strftime('%Y-%m', ordered_at) AS month,
    COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM 
    orders
WHERE 
    ordered_at LIKE '2025-%'
GROUP BY 
    month
ORDER BY 
    month;

    strftime('%Y-%m', ordered_at) AS month,
    COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM 
    orders
WHERE 
    ordered_at LIKE '2025-%'
GROUP BY 
    month
ORDER BY 
    month;
